scope: Exploratory saved-prediction analysis and observed-date missingness audit; no refit or new data

output_units.time_all_feasible_subsets.parquet: One feasible same-count set per archive; uniform probability is conditional on that archive
output_units.time_exact_random_expectations.parquet: One archive; squared errors first averaged over its uniform subsets
output_units.time_random_selection_draws.parquet: One full-cohort random-seed realization per archive; seeds are not independent climates
output_units.time_sensitivity_paired_cluster.csv: Group bootstrap of archive-conditional expected MSE or fixed MSE, then root; not a bootstrap of selected annual errors
output_units.gap_overlap_station_year_cases.csv: Incomplete observed station-year or trial station-year-replicate; peer denominator excludes group-years without another evaluable station
